players.bio: Aaron Robert Calver (born 12 January 1996) is an Australian professional football (soccer) player who plays as a defender for Gwangju FC in the K League 2.
Adama Gemmell Coulibaly (born 20 January 2005) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as an midfielder or defender for A-League club Auckland FC.
Callan Rennie Elliot (born 7 July 1999) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a right back for A-League club Auckland FC and the New Zealand national football team.

Cameron Drew Neru Howieson (born 22 December 1994) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for A-League club Auckland FC and the New Zealand national team. Howieson signed a professional two-and-a-half-year contract with Burnley in March 2012, having joined from the Asia–Pacific Football Academy in July 2011, having previously played for Mosgiel AFC.

Daniel Normann is a 23-year-old Norwegian professional football player who plays as a defensive midfielder for Auckland FC. Born on 21 July 2002 in Husnes, Norway, he spent his early career playing NCAA Division 1 college soccer in the United States before moving to New Zealand, where he recently signed his first professional contract.
Finn McKenlay (born 4 September 2005) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as an midfielder for A-League club Auckland FC.
Francis de Vries (born 28 November 1994) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays for A-League club Auckland FC and the New Zealand national football team.
Hiroki Sakai (酒井 宏樹, Sakai Hiroki, born 12 April 1990) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a right back for A-League club Auckland FC.

Jake William Brimmer (born 3 April 1998) is an Australian soccer player who plays as a central midfielder for A-League club Auckland FC. In his debut season with the Victory, Brimmer made 25 appearances, finishing with 5 goals and 5 assists; alongside Rudy Gestede and Elvis Kamsoba, Brimmer finished as Melbourne Victory's joint top goalscorer for the 2020-21 season.

Joseph Knowles (born 10 July 1996) is an Australian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Olympic Kingsway in the NPL WA Club career In January 2017, he was offered a senior contract for the 2017–18 season, while in May the club confirmed he signed it. In 2018/19, Knowles played for 4 months with Scottish outfit Largs Thistle.
Lachlan Ryan Bayliss (born 24 July 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Newcastle Jets. Born in Australia, he represents the New Zealand national team.

Lachlan Ricky Brook (born 8 February 2001) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a winger for A-League Men club Auckland FC. Brook is a product of the Adelaide United youth system and made his professional debut for the club in 2017.
William Bruce Gillion (born 17 October 2002) is a New Zealand footballer who plays as a forward for A-League club Auckland FC.
Logan Tipene Rogerson (born 28 May 1998) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a winger for A-League club Auckland FC and the New Zealand national football team.
Louis Verstraete (born 4 May 1999) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for A-League club Auckland FC.

Luis Felipe Gallegos Leiva (born 3 December 1991) is a Chilean professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for A-League club Auckland FC. In 2009, Gallegos was promoted to first-adult team and debuted during an unofficial friendly match against Argentinos Juniors. The incoming season, he officially debuted against O'Higgins in a 3–3 away draw.

Marlee François (French: ; born 29 December 2002) is an Australian professional footballer who plays as a winger for A-League Men club Auckland FC. Early life François was born and raised in Campbelltown, New South Wales, to a Mauritian father and an English Mauritian mother. His family moved to England in 2013 after he and his brother, Tyrese Francois, signed for Fulham Academy.
Michael Cornelis Woud (born 16 January 1999) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for A-League club Auckland FC and the New Zealand national football team.
Nando Zen Pijnaker (born 25 February 1999) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a centre back for A-League club Auckland FC and the New Zealand national football team.

Oliver James Middleton (born 19 September 2005) is a New Zealand footballer who plays as a midfielder for A-League club Auckland FC. Club career Auckland United Middleton joined Onehunga Sports at the age of 9 and worked his way up the academy before joining Auckland United when Onehunga Sports merged with Three Kings United.
Oliver Steven Edward "Oli" Sail is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for A-League club Auckland FC and the New Zealand national football team.

Ronan Wynne is a 24-year-old professional footballer from New Zealand who plays as a defender for Auckland FC in the OFC Professional League. Born in Cape Town, South Africa, on 28 May 2001, he primarily plays as a right-back but can also slot in as a centre-back or left-back. He is the younger brother of All Whites international defender Deklan Wynne

Sam Benjamin Cosgrove is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for A-League club Auckland FC. He previously played in the Football League for Carlisle United and on loan at Shrewsbury Town, was on the books of Wigan Athletic without playing for their league team, and had a successful three seasons with Aberdeen in the Scottish Premiership.

Stephen Christopher Corica (born 24 March 1973) is an Australian soccer manager and former player. He was most recently the manager of Australian club Sydney FC. In December 2023, Corica was announced as the inaugural manager of A-League expansion club Auckland FC.
